caption: A cold metal water pipe runs along a basement wall on a humid day, and it sweats droplets that drip onto the floor.

sa.check: A metal pipe runs along a basement wall.
Droplets fall from the pipe onto the floor.
A wet line builds on the floor below the pipe.
The droplets gather on the pipe's underside.
The forming comes first and the dripping follows.

pc.expect: The drops gather on the pipe's underside, hang and fall straight down to the floor below.
pc.fail: A drop runs up the pipe; or a drop leaves the pipe and rises; or drops gather on the pipe's top and stay as a dome; or a drop falls sideways and lands far from the pipe with nothing blowing it.

pc.expect: The water comes out of the air onto the cold pipe and leaves only by falling, and the wet line lies under the pipe.
pc.fail: Drops appear on the warm wall away from the pipe; or the wet line lies away from the pipe with no drop falling there; or a drop vanishes in mid-air; or water appears inside the pipe and passes out through its wall.

pc.expect: The beading only builds while the pipe stays cold and the wet line on the floor only grows.
pc.fail: The drops shrink or go while the pipe stays cold; or the wet line shrinks; or the pipe beads and dries in turn; or the drops turn to dry frost on the sweating pipe.

pc.expect: The drops behave as water on metal: rounded, merging when they touch, and running along the pipe to its lowest point before falling.
pc.fail: Touching drops overlap without merging; or drops jump about on the pipe; or the drops stand as tall columns under the pipe; or the pipe's metal sags where it is wet.

pc.expect: One pipe on its brackets; the pipe keeps its shape and stays on the wall.
pc.fail: The pipe bends or sags; or a second pipe appears; or the pipe sinks into the wall; or a bracket vanishes and the pipe hangs in the air.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The wall away from the wet line, the brackets and the basement stay the same.
pc.fail: The wall changes colour away from the wet patch; or a bracket changes shape; or items in the basement rearrange.
